summary: Issue #30 completion: bounded structured machine error codes now survive the Hub /jobs service catch and the Hub client. Added a shared pure bounded-code contract (src/structured-error-code.mjs): a machine code is an uppercase snake-style identifier of at most 64 characters (isBoundedMachineCode / boundedMachineCodeFromError, code then policyCode, never derived from error text). Wired the Hub /jobs catch in src/hub/index.mjs to emit an optional top-level `code` only when err.code / err.policyCode is a valid bounded machine code, preserving the raw error text; the file remains CRLF-only with only the intended semantic hunk (git diff shows +6/-3 lines, no EOL churn). Tightened src/hub-client.mjs structuredCode to the same bounded rule so malformed/lowercase/oversized values never become client error codes and the client falls back to HUB_REQUEST_FAILED. No routing/retry/escalation/adaptive/policy semantics changed; code is not inferred from error text and arbitrary response payload fields are never copied. Validation: targeted tests 26/26, full deterministic node --test 420/420, pnpm run build:client PASS, git diff --check PASS (repo-local core.whitespace=cr-at-eol so git honors the repository's CRLF convention), and the required CRLF-only check PASS. Pure code-only work: dsh-crew was not installed, started, or registered in any DSH profile; no profile/config/credential touched; dsh-crew remains uninstalled (dsh_crew_must_remain_uninstalled respected).
